key_findings: FDA approved suzetrigine (Journavx) in January 2025 as the first non-opioid analgesic for moderate-to-severe acute pain in 25 years.
Suzetrigine selectively inhibits NaV1.8 by binding VSD2, with comparable efficacy to HB/APAP and fewer adverse events.
